summary: Share stable Quick access destinations, person-owned Pins identity and server-ordered edit plans

replay.detail: Existing ordered membership and arrangement claims remain authoritative; no history is rewritten.

schema.detail: No wire or storage shape changes; clients reuse the reserved version-2 Pins identity.

rules.detail: Existing owner, lifecycle visibility and ordered membership rules apply. Local inventory never removes a shortcut.

compatibility.detail: Creation remains disabled unless the host explicitly asserts the coordinated version-2 reader rollout. Existing readable Pins remain editable with granted control.

downtime.detail: The shared helper requires no daemon restart.

manual.detail: No arrangement is created by reading or importing this model.

recovery.detail: Reverting this model retains the existing server memberships.
